The bonus increases by +1 for every three caster levels above 7th, to a maximum of +6 at 19th level. It stacks with the target's normal natural armor but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor.

spells/arms-of-plenty-1542.name: Arms of Plenty
spells/arms-of-plenty-1542.effectSummary: Grows two clawed arms that grant two primary claw attacks. Each claw deals 1d6 slashing damage, or 1d4 for a Small creature, plus Strength and counts as magic for overcoming damage reduction; the claws cannot wield weapons or manipulate objects. The subject can make the claw attacks in addition to weapon attacks without penalty. If both claws hit the same target, they rend for 2d6 plus 1-1/2 times Strength. Multiple castings do not stack and only reset the duration.

spells/arrow-mind-367.name: Arrow Mind
spells/arrow-mind-367.effectSummary: While wielding a qualifying bow, the caster threatens all squares within normal melee reach with the bow and can make attacks of opportunity by shooting arrows. The caster also does not provoke attacks of opportunity for firing a bow while inside another creature's threatened area.

spells/arrow-mind-3845.effectSummary: While wielding an arrow-firing projectile weapon such as a longbow or shortbow, the caster threatens all squares within normal melee reach with it and can make attacks of opportunity by firing. spells/arrow-of-bone-3846.name: Arrow of Bone
spells/arrow-of-bone-3846.effectSummary: Transforms one missile or thrown weapon into a bone weapon that gains +4 enhancement on attack and damage when used in its next ranged attack. A living creature hit must make a Fortitude save or die instantly; on a successful save it instead takes 3d6 damage +1 per caster level, maximum +20. The magic is discharged and the projectile destroyed after the attack whether it hits or misses.
